PRODUCT CATEGORY

Sheet and Roll Products

Saniteks produces the non-woven cleaning cloth and scouring felt used in cleaning products in rolls in its own plant. We also supply these rolls to manufacturers developing other products.

Our products can be supplied in roll and sheet form. Properties such as grammage, thickness, colour and size are agreed together according to your needs.
